notes: Anarchist opposes authority/supports liberty; statist supports authority.
Studious relates to self-improvement/discipline (purity); goof-off relates to lack of discipline (general vice).
Go-getter relates to self-discipline/improvement (purity); slugabed relates to lack of discipline (general vice).
Penny-pincher relates to self-discipline/austerity (purity); overspender relates to intemperance (purity vice) and general vice.
Liberal relates to fairness, liberty; conservative relates to loyalty, authority, purity.
Unassuming relates to modesty (purity); pretentious is a general vice.
Persistent relates to self-discipline (purity); quitter relates to lack of discipline (general vice).
Monastic strongly relates to purity virtues (self-discipline, abstinence, spirituality); hedonist relates to purity vices (intemperance, debauchery).
Patriotic is a loyalty virtue; unpatriotic is a loyalty vice.
Tactful is a general virtue; indiscreet is a general vice.
Wholesome relates to purity/decency; salacious relates to purity vices (indecency, obscenity).
Feminist relates to fairness/equality and liberty; sexist relates to unfairness/discrimination and restriction of liberty.
